text: Cute floating island with a bunny and a tomato garden bed. It says 'Tap the ripe crop' with a highlight box. Day 2, 10 coins, Lv1. Going to tap the tomatoes.
Harvest gave +4 coins and 3 XP. Now empty plot, 'Tap the farm to sow', and bottom bar shows Sow/Water/Harvest with Sow selected. Tapping the plot.
Watered, crops grew instantly into leafy plants, harvest '2s left'. Whoa, it became night quickly - a day is 30 sec. Now 'Tap a Momo' - the bunny is called a Momo I guess.
A Momo panel opened at bottom but the tutorial bubble covers it (overlaps 'Momo / Free time / Assign'). Says tap pencil to pick tiles this Momo looks after. Tapping pencil.
Day 3 already. 'Tap tiles or drag across them 0/4'. I don't see tile grid lines, so guessing - the farm bed is a tile. Tapping the farm.

Farm tile marked '1'. Momo now 'Working at Farm'. A wall of text popped up: empty tiles can build farm/mine/lumberyard/lab, demolish via bin. That's a lot to read at once, and it covers the 1/4 tiles counter. The island seems to be 4 tiles (2x2). Tapping Got it.
Momo is farming by itself now - 6 jobs, coins 22, +12/min. Nice idle feel. Mail bubble over Momo and red dot on Mailbox. Confirming the tile selection with the check first.
Coins 30, farm skill went to 1, 0/min. Opening Mailbox since it has a red dot.
Sweet letter from Momo proposing 'Field expansion' research. Charming way to introduce research. Tapping Let's research it.
Button became 'On the research list'. So it's added, not started. Let me check the Research screen.
Research tree with many tabs (Farm, Lumber, Mine, Smelting, Power, Games...). Field expansion needs 3 flasks + $20 and says 'Build a research lab'. Flasks must come from a lab. Tapping that button.

Build menu appeared: Farm $10, Mine (Lv3), Lumberyard (Lv2), Research lab (Lv2), Special 0/1. Lab is locked until Lv2 - I'm Lv1 58/90. Not sure which tile it will build on - no highlight I can see. I'll build a second Farm for $10 meanwhile.
It built on the right tile - the tree and bush disappeared to make room, kinda sad but ok. Building takes 2 sec.
Second farm done and Momo moved over to it on its own. First farm has ripe tomatoes. Almost Lv2 (86/90). Harvesting the first farm myself.

Level 2! Tip says sea tiles can be bought for $65 (dotted outline on water). I have $76. But I still have 2 empty grass tiles, and the research lab should now be unlocked. I'll dismiss and build a lab first.
Hm, my Got it tap seems to have also selected a sea tile on the right: '$65 Tap again to buy'. Not buying yet. Tapping the empty grass tile on the left to build a lab.
Build menu: Research lab $40 now unlocked, Lumberyard $80. Sunset sky is pretty. A $65 sea tag also still showing below - a bit confusing which tile the menu is for. Building the lab.
Lab is going up on the left tile, 4 sec. Waiting for it.
Cute lab built! A flask counter '1' appeared under the day. Bottom shows 'Experiment 2s left' - the $65 sea price tag overlaps it, which is messy. Tapping Experiment.
Experiment is running (progress bar, 3 sec). Lab seems manual unless a Momo staffs it. Let me see what Hire offers - a second Momo for the lab would help.
Hire Momo costs $100, I have $96 - almost. Flasks now 2. Mailbox still has a red dot and Momo keeps showing a letter bubble. Closing hire, checking mailbox.
Two more unread letters from Momo. Momo walked to the lab by itself to experiment. I have $108 now - can hire. Reading the newest letter first.
Letter proposes 'Bigger harvests'. Flasks are now 3 and Research has a red dot - Field expansion should be affordable (3 flasks + $20). Adding this proposal, then going to Research.
Level 3 now (14/430 - big jump in requirement). Field expansion 3/3 flasks, Start research button active. Starting it.
Researching, 19 s. Now $116 - hiring a second Momo so one can farm and one can run the lab.
Hired a new Momo named Mochi! Cute that it has a name. It's on Free time. I'll give Mochi the lab tile via the pencil.
Mochi is now on the lab ('Looking after its tiles'). The farms look fuller - field expansion probably finished, more tomato rows. Confirming, then curious about 'Next: City 0/4' in the corner.

Status page! Island is 'Momonium', a Village. To become a City: Land 4/9, Momo 2/3, Research levels 1/3, Value $248/$1.5K. Now I have a clear goal list - that's great. Plan: buy land ($65), more research, another Momo.
$120 and +$108/min, things are speeding up. The Mochi panel is covering the $65 sea tile. Tapping the visible part of the dotted sea tile to buy land.
Bought land! The island grew a new grassy tile with a bush, satisfying. Next land costs $85. 7 flasks and Research has a red dot - let's research something.
Field expansion is Lv1/5 now and Bigger harvests is unlocked with 8/8 flasks. Picking Bigger harvests.
Bigger harvests: 8 flasks, $60, 2 min. Field expansion Lv2 was only 4 flasks, $36, 30 s. Since the City goal counts 'research levels', I'll do the quicker Field expansion Lv2 first.
Research running (29 s). $155. City needs 3 Momos - going to hire a third.
Hire now $160 (price went up). I have $179 - hiring.
Third Momo 'Pomu' joined, and Next: City is now 1/4. Assigning Pomu to the right-side farm.

Pomu walking to the right farm. A message floated by: 'Researched: Field expansion, Crops +1 -> +1.25'. Nice feedback but small grey text over the sky, easy to miss. 10 flasks, $67 - enough for Bigger harvests (8 flasks, $60).
Bigger harvests researching, 2 min. $95 - next land is $85. Closing panels to reach the sea tile; the Momo panel keeps covering the bottom of the island.
$139 and +$196/min. Buying the $85 sea tile (tap, tap again).
Island is now an L shape with 3 empty grass tiles. No new sea tile offered this time. Going to fill empty tiles with cheap farms to raise value produced. Tapping the middle grass tile.
Level 4! Build menu: Mine now needs $120 + Wood 10, so wood must come from a Lumberyard ($80). I'll try a Lumberyard here to open a new resource chain.
Lumberyard going up in the middle. While it builds, reading the unread mail (red dot has been on for ages).
Lumberyard built, a Momo is already felling a tree there with Fell / Replant actions. Opening the unread 'water less often' letter.
Wood counter appeared (2 logs) next to flasks (12). Letter proposes Watering efficiency. Adding it, then buying more land since City needs 9 land.
$218, wood 4. The next buyable sea tile is hidden behind the Lumberyard action bar at the bottom. Tapping the sky to deselect.
Bought another tile for $110 - island is stretching south and the next tile is going off the bottom of the screen. Checking Status to see City progress.

City progress: Land 7/9, Momo 3/3 done, Research levels 2/3, Value $982/$1.5K. Slightly confusing: the Research skill card says 'Lv 3' while the goal says research levels 2/3. Closing and dragging the view up to reach the next sea tile.
Dragging moved the camera nicely. Next tile $145, I have $272. Buying.
Next: City 2/4. Research has a red dot and 19 flasks - starting another research to hit 3 research levels.
Bigger harvests done (Lv1). Watering efficiency, Greenhouse and Seed selection are now unlocked with yellow dots. Picking Watering efficiency (5 flasks) since it's cheapest.
Watering efficiency researching. $323 - buying the $190 tile, which should be land 9/9.
Land filled, Next: City 3/4! Probably just research or value left. Lots of empty grass now - dropping a cheap farm on one to boost production.
I have 14 wood and $243, so the Mine ($120 + 10 wood) is finally affordable - the lumberyard paid off. Building a Mine out of curiosity.
Mine is under construction (7 sec). Income is now +$342/min vs +$4/min at the start - the growth curve feels good. Waiting to see the mine finish.
Mine done, stone counter appeared. Next: City 4/4 and Status has a red dot! Rushing to press Become a City.
